caption:
How JobRez calculates role fit without external verification.

Role match is deterministic. It evaluates your resume against a posting using a curated technology taxonomy with aliases and whole-word matching. Required terms are weighted double and preferred terms once. There is no cloud AI and no external verification involved.

Learn more at jobrez.com.
